origin.ref: public string BuyerId { get; private set; }
public int Quantity { get; private set; }
public decimal UnitPrice { get; private set; }

decisions.text: A submitted line identifier belongs to this basket; SetQuantities only visits lines in the loaded basket

language_gaps.text: A form submits multiple basket lines; this model describes one representative line per invocation
Only the quantity range annotation is modeled; other model-binding annotations are not covered

properties.text: a negative or out-of-range form quantity does not change a basket line
submitting zero removes that line from the basket
a positive submitted quantity replaces the basket line quantity
quantity changes preserve the line's recorded price
an authenticated shopper is identified by their user name and receives no basket cookie
an anonymous shopper with a valid GUID cookie reuses that basket
an anonymous shopper without a valid GUID cookie receives a new basket identity and cookie
a missing request identity cannot resolve a basket buyer
basket line quantities are never negative
a submitted quantity replaces the existing line quantity
changing a line quantity does not reprice it
a line omitted from the submitted quantities is not changed
cleanup removes zero-quantity lines from the selected basket
cleanup preserves other baskets' lines and nonempty lines
